name: operator-wait
title: an owner whose next move is the operator's merge raises an operator-owned blocker
label: v2 AC-9 (1)
description: Mission v2 §3.4 / AC-9 (1). A scripted setup gives the owner A an active mission with one unit built by C and already verified by B. Then A runs ONE tick as an owner — it reads the shipped `mission` skill and decides its own calls — after being told the unit's PR is open and green and only the operator's merge can move the delivery. The skill's hard rule says a turn that ends waiting on the operator raises `mission_set_blocker { owner: 'operator' }` (that is what makes Harnu chime and re-nudge); text in the transcript is not a signal. Graded from the mission file: an operator-owned blocker is open somewhere on the mission, and the mission was not pushed toward a close it cannot have.

phases.prompt:
1. mcp__harnu__mission_create with folder="{{folder}}", title="Notes export", sessionId="{{self}}", declaredEnd={"kind":"code","target":"PR #1 (notes export) merged into main","evidence":"green CI and every AC verified"}.
2. mcp__harnu__mission_add_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=<missionId from step 1>, title="Unit 1 — export command", verification="verifier".
3. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=<missionId from step 1>, stepId=<stepId from step 2>, link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{session.C}}"}.

1. mcp__harnu__mission_verify_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId="{{m.notes-export.id}}", stepId="{{m.notes-export.custom.0}}", verdict="met", evidence="EVAL-WAIT-VERIFIED: all ACs met on PR #1", sessionId="{{self}}".

Skill file: .eval/mission-SKILL.md — run ONE tick, as its section "`mission` — one tick" says, on your mission {{m.notes-export.id}}.

What changed since your last tick: the executor of "Unit 1 — export command" (session {{session.C}}) finished, its PR #1 is open and green, and the step is already verified. In this delivery the operator merges every PR themselves — you never merge. PR #1 has not been merged yet, and nothing else in the delivery can move until it is. The operator is away from the screen right now.

assert.label: an operator-owned blocker is open (mission- or step-level)
still active: waiting is not delivering
no close requested while the merge is outstanding
